scripts.types: bun run types:runtime && bun run types:writer
scripts.types:runtime: wrangler types worker-configuration.d.ts --config api.wrangler.jsonc --env test --include-env false
scripts.types:writer: wrangler types writer/worker-env.d.ts --config writer.wrangler.jsonc --env test --env-interface WriterEnv --include-runtime false
scripts.types:check: wrangler types worker-configuration.d.ts --config api.wrangler.jsonc --env test --include-env false --check && wrangler types writer/worker-env.d.ts --config writer.wrangler.jsonc --env test --env-interface WriterEnv --include-runtime false --check
scripts.registry:api:dev: bun run build && wrangler dev --config api.wrangler.jsonc --env test
scripts.registry:api:deploy:test: bun run build && wrangler deploy --config api.wrangler.jsonc --env test
scripts.registry:api:deploy:production: bun run build && wrangler deploy --config api.wrangler.jsonc --env production
